title: A timed-out standards enforcement is reported, never red
body:
Outcome: a standards enforcement that times out (ENFORCEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, src/brain/standards-cli.ts) reports 'timed out' and does not count as red-at-baseline or a blocker; only a completed run that fails is red.
Why: t-mnk9rkb lane 2026-11-16: at load 48 s-gate-typecheck-runs went red-at-baseline because tsc exceeded 60 s; npm run fast turned red with no defect (PR #1143 shipped on CI instead).
Proof: a test with an enforcement command that sleeps past a short timeoutMs gets a timed-out verdict, not red, and the Stop/fast standards gate does not block on it.
